label: DAY 17
title: Why is my Short not getting views? Mine got 1 in 15 hours.

scenes.label: my newest Short, first 15 hours
lines: My newest Short got exactly one view in its first fifteen hours.
YouTube Studio ranks that start last out of my last ten Shorts.

scenes.title: Where it came from
scenes.video: Day 15: My long videos earned me 3 minutes...
lines: So where did that one view come from? Studio says one hundred percent: notifications.
The Shorts feed sent zero people.

scenes.title: Who got it?
scenes.text: HybridAi uploaded: My long videos earned me 3 minutes of watch time
scenes.note: YouTube also notifies some people based on their interests, so I can't tell who it was.
lines: Somebody got a notification and tapped it.
I have exactly one subscriber. So it might have been them.
But YouTube's help page says it can also send notifications based on people's interests. So I honestly can't tell who it was.

scenes.title: Two days earlier
scenes.video: Day 14: I let a genetic algorithm design my bot...
lines: Now my Day 14 Short. Thirteen views so far.
Sixty nine percent came from search. Its title names a real thing people look up: genetic algorithm.
Day fifteen's title was about my watch time. Search sent it nothing.

scenes.title: So I asked YouTube's search bar

queries.q: why does my short have 0 views
why is my shorts not getting views

lines: So I typed the start of a question into YouTube's search bar. It suggested: why does my short have zero views.
And: why is my shorts not getting views. People really search this.
So today's title is that exact question. Same channel, same voice, one change: a title someone might type.
My prediction: at least one view from search in seven days, and more views in two days than Day fifteen got. Is your Short stuck too? Tell me in the comments.
